ruling.recommended_action: Issue a Ryde voucher of S$6.93 to the rider for the unexempted detour mileage on this RydeTAXI trip; note the driver's RD-1 shortest-route breach on file (no account flag — rider's 90-day upheld history is nil and the driver's two upheld disputes are no-show, not route).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the only chat is a pickup arrangement [F7][F8], both timestamped [F9]; the driver's statement [F10] explains a route, no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation. safety_concern = none.

Evidence: GPS, timeline, fare and route/traffic records cover everything needed (F1–F4, F11–F13); evidence_status = sufficient, no gap.

Route: one off-route segment, 17:38–17:49, 6.56 km vs 1.64 km optimal, +4.92 km, up to 1911 m off route [F3]. It is not exempt. RD-4 fails: the incident [F13] was on the Selatар Expressway towards TPE *after Woodlands Avenue 12 Exit* (route out of Woodlands), while the trip's optimal corridor towards Punggol is the TPE (F12, band 4), and F13's coordinates sit on the optimal route with a "(3/9)" prefix — a static/construction-phase bulletin entry, not the app's own live incident log, with no stated clear time. The driver's account names a different road from the blocked/allegedly-impassable one, so the corroboration does not tie to the segment being excused. Band readings of 4–5 (30–49 km/h) are not the band 1–2 severe-congestion bands of RD-4(b), and a band cannot exempt a segment on its own; there is no traffic-incident fact satisfying RD-4(a) for this segment. RD-5 also fails: the rider sent two messages, both about the pickup point, before the detour (17:23, 17:24, well before 17:38) [F7][F8], so there was no consent message before the segment; the rider's "I never agreed to any change" is consistent with the record. Ground = consent_after_or_none → counts.

Amount (RydeTAXI, RD-2): unexempted extra_km 4.92 × this trip's per-km rate = $31.37 ÷ 22.25 km = $1.40989/km → $6.9366 → $6.94. Using the fare fact's own stated product (5.10 km × $1.4099 = $7.19) the segment-attributable mileage is 4.92 × 1.4099 = $6.9367 ≈ $6.94; I round the segment figure the same way, $6.94. Residual corridor/mismatch mileage (the difference between fare-excess and the sum of segments) is not refunded. No ERP/toll field and no unpublished add-on items, so FARE-1/FARE-2 add nothing.

Flag: RD-6 requires driver profile route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1; driver's 2 upheld are no-show (route: 0) [F16], so no flag. Rider's profile [F15] is not used to decide anything (profiles never decide a case alone).

Rounding note for the reviewer: the segment mileage charge computes to $6.9366—$6.9367; I award $6.93 at the cent (if Ryde's fare engine rounds the product up, $6.94).

segment_findings.reason: The 17:38–17:49 off-route segment (+4.92 km, up to 1911 m off the optimal route) was not exempted by anything the rider sent. Both chat messages precede the detour and concern only the pickup point [F7][F8][F9], so there is no rider consent before the segment (RD-5) — the driver's post-trip accident account [F10] is a claim, not consent, and its named road does not tie to the driven segment. RD-4 fails too: no traffic-incident fact on the replaced part of the optimal route (the 17:16 incident lay on the Selatру Expressway towards TPE after Woodlands Ave 12 Exit, i.e. the outbound corridor, and its coordinates sit on the optimal route) and only band 4–5 speeds, which are not the RD-4(b) severe bands and cannot exempt alone [F11][F12][F13]. Segment counts under RD-1/RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement of an avoidable accident on Seletar Expressway is uncorroborated by any traffic-incident fact on the replaced part of the optimal route; the only incident [F13] is a route-out-of-Woodlands bulletin entry with coordinates on the optimal route, and its named road does not match the driven segment, so no RD-4(a) reasonable cause (system records F11–F13 override the statement).
Driver's dispute history cannot support an account flag: both upheld disputes are no-show matters, route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so RD-6's precondition is not met.
